newsitem.title: CHINA: Death toll in China rail crash seen above 100.
newsitem.headline: Death toll in China rail crash seen above 100.

text.p: The death toll from a train crash in central China could exceed 100 after rescue workers clawed on Wednesday into the wreckage of a carriage that could not be reached earlier, officials said.
"There is little doubt that the death toll will be about 100 or more," one official in Yueyang county in central Hunan province said by telephone.

Rescue workers used cranes to winch aside wreckage of the two trains and open a carriage that they had been unable to reach since the crash at Rongjiawan station in Yueyang county on Tuesday morning, the official said.
More bodies and injured were found inside the carriage, he said.
Local media officials said the toll had already exceeded 100 but declined to give a specific figure.
Government officials handling the rescue work declined to say how many had been killed or injured in the crash, one of the worst in China for several years.
